productPage.title: Jahe Padjajaran Ginger Candy
productPage.tagline: Ginger candy made from natural spices, produced hygienically in Depok, West Java.
productPage.intro: Jahe Padjajaran is a ginger-based hard candy produced by PT Padjajaran Pratama Wijaya. It carries the warm, sharp character of Indonesian ginger, with a slow-dissolving texture that keeps the warmth in the throat. The product is made for everyday use — while travelling, in cold weather, or whenever the throat feels uncomfortable.
productPage.barcodeIntro: Every pack of Jahe Padjajaran carries the official barcode below. Use this number to confirm that the product you bought comes from PT Padjajaran Pratama Wijaya.
productPage.ctaText: We are open to distribution partnerships with stores, wholesalers and distributors. Pricing and margin details are on the partnership page.

digitalLink.lead: This page is the official destination of the barcode printed on Jahe Padjajaran packaging. If you arrived here by scanning the code on a pack, the product you are holding is registered to PT Padjajaran Pratama Wijaya.
